newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RAYO VALLECANO IN TALKS WITH MARADONA, NEWSPAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAYO VALLECANO IN TALKS WITH MARADONA, NEWSPAPER SAYS.

text.p: Spanish side Rayo Vallecano are studying the possibility of signing Diego Maradona, the Spanish sports daily Marca said on on Saturday.
"There have been contacts with Rayo... We have only talked, anything could happen, we don't discard anything," said Guillermo Coppola, Maradona's representative.
The former Argentina world cup captain, who has been playing at Boca Juniors, is in Madrid undergoing medical tests after spending 10 days in a Swiss clinic to try to beat a drugs habit.
He has been invited to attend Rayo's match on Sunday against Celta Vigo, and may even be asked to take the honourary kick-off which starts many Spanish matches.
Traditionally regarded as Madrid's third team behind neighbouring giants Real and Atletico, Rayo matches usually draw crowds of fewer than 10,000.
Maradona's brother Hugo turned out 29 times for the side between 1988 and 1990, scoring three goals.
